prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character modeling reference sheet for Magic Animals. Input image is the approved original Milo style benchmark, NOT an edit target. Design an original animal sibling in exactly the same visual family: premium cinematic stylized 3D maquette, very cute child-friendly large rounded head (~45% of body height excluding species ears), compact torso, short separate limbs, rounded paws, broad soft smile and sculpted muzzle, oversized expressive eyes with colored iris detail, pupils and soft catchlights, eyelids integrated naturally, soft short fur, fabric weave, visible seams/cuffs/zipper/pockets and natural folds. Same production quality as the kitten. Three full-body consistent orthographic views on ONE landscape sheet, FRONT, LEFT SIDE facing left, BACK, equal scale aligned feet and head, evenly spaced, whole figure unclipped including tail/ears. Identical relaxed A-pose rotated between views: both arms 30 degrees out from torso, slightly separated feet, actual visible clear gaps under arms; hands open rounded mittens. Hood down behind head in all views. Same garment construction as Milo with open hood, lining, zipper and ribbed cuffs. Same warm neutral taupe seamless background and soft studio lighting, gentle contact shadow. Strict shape/color/costume continuity across three views. No text, labels, graphics, props, ground horizon, logos, watermarks or franchise costumes. NOT flat 2D, NOT primitive capsule model, NOT realistic wild animal, NOT plastic toy. Do not include the cat. Species FOX: warm orange-russet fur, creamy muzzle/chest and paw tips, delicate pointed fox ears with soft edges, slightly longer tapered but rounded muzzle, fluffy cheeks, a large bushy curved tail with cream tip visible clearly in side/back view. Cozy muted sage-green zip hoodie. Expressive amber-gold irises. Gentle curious smile; no fangs.

edits.prompt: Edit target: image 1 fox turnaround. Supporting pose reference: image 2 Milo front A-pose. Keep the exact original fox design, colors, face, clothing details, lighting and three-view landscape layout. Change ONLY both arm poses: in FRONT and BACK lift the upper arms about 35 degrees from downward vertical, elbows soft, rounded hands clearly separated from hips, so underarm triangular gaps are visible like image 2. SIDE must be the same A-pose rotated (forearm slightly occluded naturally). Preserve all three views of same fox, equal scale and aligned feet, all parts within canvas. No text.

Edit target: first image, the Pebble panda three-view turnaround. Style reference: second image Milo. Preserve exact panda identity, warm brown eyes, black-white fur pattern, three orthographic views and layout, full body, same relaxed A-pose, same gray-sage hoodie color, lighting and background. Change ONLY hoodie sleeves: replace the incorrect exposed black upper arms plus detached fabric bands with NORMAL FULL-LENGTH CONTINUOUS soft fabric sleeves from shoulder seam to wrist cuffs, exactly like Milo's hoodie. No exposed fur between shoulder and cuff; black paws remain visible below cuffs. Ensure sleeve cloth connects properly in ALL THREE views and retains folds and knitted wrist cuffs. No text, logos, added accessories, or changes to face/body.
